background_red.assertion: Without queue dispatch, background run_once ignored the approved command and entered builder runtime readiness.

verified: The background run_once entry point consumes admitted command jobs through the shared targeted service. Productive work explicitly retains Background execution mode.
Persistent scheduling rotates oldest attempts, preserves a five-minute retry floor across restart, and yields a normal automatic-lane turn between command jobs.
Two concurrent SQLite connections cannot reserve the same scheduling turn. Selection creates no workflow checkpoint and consumes no merge allowance.
Held, retired, merged, merge-stage, future-eligible, actively leased and PR-only AwaitChecks jobs are excluded from productive queue selection.
Real-Git regression verifies a queued approved PR reaches exactly one merge through background run_once, without another model call, repository-wide discovery or changes to owner files/index/HEAD.
limits: Runs through the existing worker build-loop cadence and merge-capacity admission; the five-minute retry floor is not a five-minute pickup SLA.
The background approved-PR regression uses real Git with scripted GitHub/review boundaries, not live GitHub or native-model acceptance.
Scheduler selection grants neither a workflow lease nor merge authority. Productive execution uses Background deployment readiness; approved reconciliation retains existing free sweep gates.
Wait/control commands, queue wake-up latency, stale-input re-verification, legacy-hold recovery, Discord sessions/updates, native CLI acceptance, production rollout and required soaks remain open.
